issue_context.title: stm32h747i_disco: Wrong Power supply setting LDO
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Clock_control driver for STM32H7 set LDO as powersupply source.
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/29c838ed1dc9aa2520051b670d387b3d4d02187c/drivers/clock_control/clock_stm32_ll_h7.c#L262
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/29c838ed1dc9aa2520051b670d387b3d4d02187c/drivers/clock_control/clock_stm32_ll_h7.c#L278

But on stm32h747i_disco board, both power supply, SMPS or LDO, are supported.
And SMPS is the default hardware configuration (can be changed by some solder bridge).
See https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/dm00504240-discovery-kit-with-stm32h747xi-mcu-stmicroelectronics.pdf
chapter **5.2.3 SMPS/LDO power supply**

As a consequence, after running zephyr firmware on this board out of the box,
a deadlock occurs ( see chapter 5.2.3 SMPS/LDO power supply):
> Caution: A deadlock occurs if the board SMPS/LDO firmware PWR configuration does not match the
> hardware configuration: after the reset, the ST-LINK cannot connect the target anymore

Thankfully a method is explained to recover the situation.
But driver should be changed to avoid entering this deadlock situation.

I havnt seen any deadlock with stm32h747i_disco board. Test methods was as follows. 

1. Used GDB to put breakpoint in all function that called LL_PWR_ConfigSupply. And I have observed LDO settings were called second. For reference I have pasted debugger log below:

2. I have comented LL_PWR_ConfigSupply(LL_PWR_LDO_SUPPLY); were ever it was called and run.

OK, I don't know exactly how to reproduce, I was excepting that your Test methods should be sufficient.
Nevertheless I think there is still a latent issue, as behavior is described in board's user manual,
And there is still an incoherence between LDO setting in `clock_stm32_ll_h7.c` and SMPS setting in `soc_m7.c`
Also, as the board can support both LDO and SMPS, it could be interesting to have the capability to select which one to use from software point of view (with Kconfig for example, or DT).
So I removed 2.6.0 milestone, and we could come back on this issue issue later
